d:
Dylan Larkin has been traded to the Montreal Canadiens in a blockbuster deal with the Detroit Red Wings!
After months of trade speculation, losing his captaincy and a suspension by Detroit, Larkin's time with the Red Wings has officially come to an end. In return, Detroit receives Kirby Dach, top prospect Michael Hage, goaltender Sam Montembeault and four draft picks, including two conditional first-round selections. Montreal also receives two draft picks alongside Larkin.
